answer.text: Investor education, suitability assessment, KYC, risk profiling

explanation.text: The Logic: Pre-commitment services include investor awareness/education, suitability and risk profiling, and KYC documentation. The distribution kit covers KYC documentation and risk-profiling materials, and distributors must assist with suitability/risk profiling and KYC (pp. 339-340, 344). The Trap: Narrow roles such as only execution, only compliance checks or only paperwork miss the pre-investment duties. Note: Failure to take reasonable care on suitability may amount to a fraudulent or unfair trade practice (p. 348).
